notes.title: Ui update
notes.content: In the latest update, I have focused on enhancing the aesthetics of the in-game User Interface (UI). The look and feel have been refined to be more visually appealing, aiming to improve your immersion and overall gaming experience. However, this update is not just about looks. I have also added new sound effects to heighten the sense of realism and excitement in the game. These auditory enhancements should add more depth to your interactions and experiences within the game. I hope you appreciate these improvements and look forward to hearing your feedback!

notes.title: update
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are pleased to announce the latest update to our game, including the following changes:

1. Addition of a link to our Discord server directly from the main menu to facilitate exchanges within our community.
2. Implementation of a poster in the main menu to keep you informed of the latest news about the game.
3. Addition of audio for the laser and flamethrower turrets, enhancing your immersion during battles.
4. Fix of an audio bug that could interfere with the gaming experience.

We hope you enjoy these improvements. Happy gaming to all!

notes.title: Update 3.0
notes.content:
Dear player,

I am excited to present the latest update to my game, where I have added new features to enhance your gaming experience. Here's an overview of what's new:

Infinite Mode: Based on your requests, I have integrated a brand-new game mode! You can now enjoy the endless mode by accessing the level selection. Test your skills and see how far you can go as the challenges become increasingly difficult. Get ready to face endless waves of enemies and strive to achieve the highest score.

Score System: I have also introduced a scoring system to make the game more competitive. Every action you take in the game will now be rewarded with points. Try to beat your own score with each playthrough and improve yourself to achieve even more impressive results.

These new features have been developed to enrich your gaming experience. I am confident that you will appreciate these additions and have fun tackling new challenges.

Please note that I am working alone on this project and striving to provide the best gaming experience possible. Your feedback is invaluable and helps me continually improve the game.

Thank you for your support, and enjoy!

notes.title: Update 3.0
notes.content:
Dear players,

I am happy to bring you the latest update, which brings many exciting improvements and additions to our game. Here is an overview of the changes:

Modified the main menu with a complete UI overhaul for a smoother and more intuitive experience.
Added loading animations to make the waiting time more enjoyable and immersive.
Introduced a new "Settings" category that allows you to customize audio and visual settings according to your preferences.
Added new enemies to provide even more challenging encounters.
Expanded our game world with brand new maps to explore and conquer.
Integrated a flamethrower turret, a formidable weapon to deal with waves of enemies.
Implemented advanced particle systems, including smoke, fire, liquid, etc., for enhanced visual immersion.
Fixed various bugs reported by our dedicated player community.
Improved overall performance for a smoother and seamless gameplay experience.
We hope these changes will bring you even more enjoyment and entertainment during your gaming sessions. Thank you for your continued support and passion for our game.

Happy gaming!

Knight-HD
